items.title: Oracle Issues Emergency Java Update for Critical 9.1 HTTPS Trust Vulnerability
items.description: Oracle has released an emergency Java security update to address CVE-2026-91403, a critical vulnerability affecting how Java applications trust digital certificates. Published on October 21, 2026, the alert assigns the flaw a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.1 and covers Oracle Java SE and GraalVM. The update blocks affected intermediate certificate authority certificates linked to eMudhra. […] The post…

items.title: PwC Data Breach Claim – Everest Ransomware Group Claims to Have Stolen 590 GB of Data
items.description: The Everest ransomware group claims to have stolen 590.69 GB of data from PwC, the global professional services firm. This alleged data theft includes human resources records, training materials, and internal documents. However, the claims are unverified, and PwC has not yet responded. items.title: Critical Cisco Expressway Vulnerability Enables Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: Cisco has released security updates for a critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability that could let remote attackers run operating system commands as root. Tracked as CVE-2026-76466, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 9.8 and affects vulnerable Expressway devices configured in a cluster. Cisco published its advisory on October 21, 2026. items.description: Splunk has released security updates for 24 vulnerabilities in Splunk Enterprise and Splunk SOAR, including four critical flaws with CVSS scores from 9.3 to 9.9. Splunk published the fixes on October 21, 2026, across three advisories covering access control, input handling, exposed files, remote code execution, denial of service, and weak authorization checks.
